name: ortho-globe
description: The globe's own front page (Globe ⇄ Equal Earth) and the /globe/ Worker. The other /globe/ pages are their own apps (package.json servedAt "/globe/"); scripts/gather-apps.mjs builds them and adds their output so this Worker serves them at the same URLs.

scripts.build: node scripts/verify-i18n.mjs && vite build && node scripts/gather-apps.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run verify:prod && npm run deploy:built
